Name: Greenhouse-style Wood Floor Border for Alternative Textures by glymr
Author: glymr
Description:
[b]This should work with 1.6! Please let me know if you have any problems with it.[/b]

The greenhouse uses a unique wood border around the crop area. This is a simple mod that lets you use Alternative Textures to change the Wood Path to match the greenhouse-style wood border.

Note: There is another version of this flooring made by someone else. They will look similar because we both used the same vanilla assets. However, I made the version used in this mod from existing game assets.

Please let me know if you have any questions about or issues with this mod. And please endorse it if it's useful to you! Thank you. :)
